title: About Me
description: I am a researcher and university lecturer with a background in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and computer vision. My research interests lie at the intersection of representation learning, generative modeling, cognitive science, and computational neuroscience, with a particular interest in understanding the principles underlying learning and intelligent behavior. I am especially interested in mathematical perspectives on learning, including geometry, topology, and dynamical systems. Beyond research, I have experience teaching undergraduate and graduate courses, mentoring students, and supporting academic activities.
